title: Repeated records with a missing request id or message id
policy: P4: an empty, blank or non-string id is a missing id. When one id is missing, the other alone identifies the operation (a request id is unique per API request, a message id per response). Records with neither are identified by a fingerprint of timestamp, model and counters, so an identical record counts once. Any of these makes the total uncertain.
derivation: msg_04a without request id, output 50/80/120: one operation [100, 120]. req_04b without message id, output 10/20: one operation [5, 20]. One record with neither: [7, 3]. Expected [112, 143], 3 operations, 255 tokens. Identity: msg_04a and req_04b are incomplete (one id each), the third is fingerprinted.
